item.title: Former UC Berkeley quarterback Fernando Mendoza wins Heisman Trophy
item.description: Fernando Mendoza, the mercurial quarterback of No. 1 Indiana, won the Heisman Trophy on Saturday night. Mendoza played for Cal from 2022 to 2024 before transferring to Indiana in 2025.

item.title: 2 killed, 9 hurt in Brown University shooting; video of suspected shooter released amid manhunt
item.description: A shelter-in-place order remains in effect for the greater Brown University area, officials said on Saturday night.

item.title: United Airlines flight safely returns to Dulles airport after engine failure during takeoff
item.description: The plane returned to the airport after losing power in one engine, according to United Airlines.

item.title: Trump administration adds militarized zone in California along southern US border
item.description: The Trump administration is adding another militarized zone to the southern U.S. border to support border security operations - this time in California.

item.title: Remembering the victims of the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting, 13 years later
item.description: On December 14, 2012, a gunman opened fired inside Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut. The shooting killed 20 first-grade students and six educators.

item.title: Petaluma police investigating after former Harlem Globetrotter says car vandalized with racial slurs
item.description: "It was very disheartening to see." Police in the North Bay are investigating a hateful incident targeting a Harlem Globetrotter and beloved coach who had his car vandalized with racial slurs.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Chilly with widespread areas of fog overnight
item.description: Widespread areas of fog will return overnight, with low temperatures mainly in the lower 40s, but a few inland locations will have lows in the upper 30s.

item.title: San Francisco Jewish leader was classmates with Australian rabbi gunned down at Bondi Beach
item.description: "Our hearts are heavy right now." The Bay Area's Jewish community gathered for the first night of Hanukkah, but there is sadness, along with safety concerns, in the wake of the deadly shooting in Australia.

item.title: Director Rob Reiner and wife Michele Singer stabbed to death in their LA home, sources say
item.description: "This is a devastating loss for our city and our country," Mayor Karen Bass said.

item.title: Rob Reiner mourned by Barack Obama, Jerry O'Connell, James Woods and many others
item.description: Many prominent people are paying tribute to Rob Reiner and his wife Michele, after they were killed in their Los Angeles home.
